samples.text:
The maps shows the grounds of a secondary school in 2000 and 2024. Overall, the school has more buildings and sports facilities now, but the main building, the car park and the playground did not changed.

In 2000, the main school building was in the centre with a road going to School Lane in the south. There was a big playing field in the north-west, a car park in the south-west and a playground in front of the main building. In the east there was a gym, and in the north there was a small staff room and a large garden in the north-east.

By 2024, the playing field became smaller because a science block was built on the east part of it. The staff room was removed. The gym was replaced by a bigger sports hall, and a canteen was built to the east of it. Also, the garden is not there anymore, there is tennis courts and a vegetable garden in the north-east now.
samples.why: Overview present but simple · key changes identified though some explanation is mechanical · limited linking · adequate vocabulary · errors in verb form, agreement and a comma splice, none blocking meaning.

samples.text:
The maps illustrate how the grounds of a secondary school changed between 2000 and 2024. Overall, the school has gained several new buildings and sports facilities, mainly at the expense of green space, while the central part of the site has remained largely unchanged.

Several features were unaffected. The main school building still stands in the centre, connected to School Lane in the south by the same road, and both the car park in the south-west and the playground in front of the main building have been kept.

In the north of the site, however, the playing field has been reduced to just over half of its original width, as a science block now occupies its eastern section. The small staff room that stood to the north of the main building has been demolished. Further east, the garden has disappeared and in its place there are now tennis courts and a smaller vegetable garden.

On the eastern side of the main building, the gym has been replaced by a larger sports hall, and a canteen, which did not exist in 2000, has been built next to it on the east.
samples.why: Clear overview · logical organisation separating unchanged and changed features · range of cohesive devices · good vocabulary (at the expense of, occupies) · mostly accurate with minimal errors.

samples.text:
The plans compare the grounds of a secondary school in 2000 and 2024. The overall trend has been one of expansion, with new teaching, sports and catering facilities added largely on former open ground, whereas the core of the school, including its access road, car park and playground, was preserved.

The main building remains at the centre of the site, reached from School Lane to the south by the original road, with the playground directly in front of it and the car park in the south-western corner. To its east, however, the modest gym has been replaced by a sports hall of greater size, beyond which a canteen has been added.

The most substantial changes have taken place in the northern half of the grounds. The playing field, which formerly extended across much of the north-west, has been cut back to a narrower strip to make room for a science block, and the small staff room nearby has been removed. Meanwhile, the garden in the north-east has been divided between tennis courts and a vegetable garden, the latter occupying the far eastern edge.
samples.why: Clear, well-placed overview · changes grouped logically with precise locations · smooth referencing (beyond which, the latter) · wide, natural vocabulary · complex structures used accurately throughout.
